Mymensingh-12 (added 2026) has a broken Unicode text layer: gazette and coordinates read from the rendered page (ROW_FIXES_BY_DIV); its printed coordinates have malformed seconds and are not used. Mymensingh-01's gazette reference shares text lines with the description and is read from the rendered page. Mymensingh-04's printed coordinates fall in Sakhipur, Tangail (outside the division) and are not used. Coordinates are as published (DMS) on 15 of 18 rows. Point-in-polygon QA against hdx_cod_ab_bgd_mymensingh ran (HDX district spelling 'Netrakona' read as Netrokona): every used point falls in its listed district and upazila (Mymensingh-02/03 in the Mymensingh City Corporation polygon, listed as Mymensingh Sadar). Descriptions are not copied; only a construction-date phrase. Licence not stated.
